annotations.title: Find records in a sheet table

description: Records from a table tab, keyed by field name, with optional where / sort / search / limit (max 500). For counts, sums and joins, napkin_sheets_query runs SQL over tables too (each table is an SQL table with an id column).

table.description: The table tab's name or id.

op.description: is (default), is_not, contains, not_contains, gt, gte, lt, lte, empty, not_empty, any_of, none_of, checked, unchecked

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this.

name: napkin_tables_query
title: Find records in a sheet table
